# T5bc v3 candidate pilot — partial results after hard stop

**Status: HARD_STOP_PARTIAL_EVIDENCE; T5bc is INCOMPLETE.** Code freeze: `b0a9230f0711c7b81af9d868a98d0eb537ad6eb9`. Authorization: `T5bc prompt 2026-09-19`. No frozen v2.1 row, provider, binary, 20_FINALIZE artifact, original 28 figure group or render manifest was replaced.

The matrix stopped at `BY2__F04__B3__D57_seed_00`. The original sealed hard-stop records remain unchanged. A report-only adjudication identifies the preregistered no-valid-heading-input condition; it does not admit the failed run for evaluation or authorize automatic continuation.

## Identity, input and configuration gates

The candidate SHA256 is `cbf554baf9c83490e40b207b97f04ef77f51d9962f7bce463f1e644416ef789e`; the frozen scalar binary remains `96ae436d82ba8922c68382bd73fc42c8bf4bcb22d72a43a8bd05f506043a9c1c`. Both BY2 identity runs reproduced the frozen NAV_10HZ.csv.gz bytes and all 211 static effective-options fields. F02 NAV SHA256: `ff31bf5a4b7004eb4ce5e91429ecf2e55586dc591bf01efcfa2fd9a99f740512`; F04: `c0292d7b307c3a920e29612a7685d303a6a13a1bf19588459492f535318f3701`.

All 64 provider bundles (three sequence bundles plus 61 subset bundles) passed the byte gates. Independent review checked 256 GNSS tables / 396580 rows: non-yaw tokens and whitespace were unchanged. B3 scalar yaw_valid is zero throughout. Sidecar time tokens match frozen GNSS rows exactly. D57 has 3321 rows and zero valid inputs (3314 inverse-time mismatches; 7 without an exact R5 reference epoch). There was no time repair or interpolation.

All emitted effective-options echoes passed their registered comparison. Successful B3 clones changed only gnsspath and appended four model keys. D57 exited before emitting an echo; its D6 b result is UNAVAILABLE_NOT_EMITTED, not PASS. The post-stop checkpoint rehashed all 660 protected pins and passed.

## D27 failure and D57 controller defect

D27 completed the native process but violated the frozen D8 speed bound: first excess at NAV row 84, time 66.403074 s, speed 57.64570678081884 m/s against 50 m/s; maximum 92.07162646082078 m/s. The classification is ALGORITHM_FAILURE_DIVERGED. Original NAV/STD remain sealed; both evaluators were skipped with no metrics admitted. D12 was not invoked.

D57 completed all 56642 propagation loops with expected and actual position/velocity/heading-attempt counts 1365/1371/0. All 3321 sidecar rows were invalid. The formal activation guard then raised an error before RUN_MANIFEST, NAV, STD and B3 diagnostics were written. The actual stderr was:

```text
legsa_v23_port_core_demo failed: FAIL_CLEAN1_METHOD_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: actual formal module activation counters mismatch
```

`port_demo.cpp:130` adds the fixed demo prefix. The frozen `t5bc_runtime.py` classifier compares stderr against the bare reason, so its exact_formal_counter_error predicate is false even though every other predicate passed independent review. The report-only scientific classification is ALGORITHM_FAILURE_NO_VALID_HEADING_INPUT; the execution status remains the original HARD_STOP. No echo, NAV, STD, diagnostic or metric is fabricated.

The frozen controller rejects persisted controller/slot hard stops and has no preregistered append-only adjudication-consumption interface. It was not bypassed, patched or resumed. The complete concrete repair and continuation-control requirements are in `<T5BC_ROOT>/09_HANDOFF/PARTIAL_V1/CONTINUATION_REPAIR_PROPOSAL.md`; this proposal is not implemented, tested or code frozen. The previous 255 passing tests did not cover the real stderr-prefix boundary.

## Handoff and continuation ceiling

A separately named `t5bc_v3_candidate_pilot_partial_v1_handoff.zip` preserves the complete current artifact tree, all old seals and hard stops, member SHA256/CRC32, slot inventories, completed rows, diagnostics and the unapplied repair proposal. It is explicitly a partial-evidence package, not the requested completed pilot handoff. Its whole-package SHA256 and byte count are recorded outside the ZIP to avoid a self-hash cycle, and appended to this tracked record after verification.
